description: This Java source file defines the GridFactory class, responsible for creating and retrieving ModelGrid objects from XML resource files, web requests, or document objects. It manages caching, resource resolution, and grid creation logic within the Ofbiz widget framework.

classes.name: GridFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing ModelGrid objects from XML resources, web requests, or document objects, including caching and resource resolution within the Ofbiz widget framework.

methods.name: getGridsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and parses a grid configuration XML file from a given resource location and returns a map of grid names to ModelGrid objects.

methods.name: getGridFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a single ModelGrid by name from a specified resource location, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getGridFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelGrid by name from the web application context associated with an HTTP request, with caching based on context parameters.

methods.name: readGridDocument
methods.description: Processes an XML Document object to extract all grid definitions and create a map of ModelGrid objects.

methods.name: createModelGrid
methods.description: Constructs a ModelGrid object from either a Document or Element, representing a specific grid definition.
